args.sql:
WITH SensorQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t1.sensres * t2.pollratehz * t1.dpires) / 1000 AS sensor_quality_score
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
),
ComfortIndex AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t3.gripdur * CASE t3.tempres 
            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
            END 
            * CASE t3.humidres 
                WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
                WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
                ELSE 0 
                END) AS comfort_index
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
),
PremiumDevices AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN t3.tempres = 'Premium' AND t3.humidres = 'Premium' THEN 'Yes' 
            ELSE 'No' 
            END AS is_premium
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
)
SELECT 
    t1.makername, 
    t1.modnum, 
    t1.dpires AS dpi_resolution, 
    t2.pollratehz AS polling_rate, 
    sq.sensor_quality_score, 
    ci.comfort_index, 
    pd.is_premium
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    SensorQuality AS sq ON t1.devregistry = sq.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    ComfortIndex AS ci ON t1.devregistry = ci.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    PremiumDevices AS pd ON t1.devregistry = pd.devregistry
ORDER BY 
    sq.sensor_quality_score DESC, 
    ci.comfort_index DESC;

    SensorQuality AS sq ON t1.devregistry = sq.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    ComfortIndex AS ci ON t1.devregistry = ci.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    PremiumDevices AS pd ON t1.devregistry = pd.devregistry
ORDER BY 
    sq.sensor_quality_score DESC, 
    ci.comfort_index DESC;

WITH SensorQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t1.sensres * t2.pollratehz * t1.dpires) / 1000 AS sensor_quality_score
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
),
ComfortIndex AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t3.gripdur * CASE t3.tempres 
            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
            END 
            * CASE t3.humidres 
                WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
                WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
                ELSE 0 
                END) AS comfort_index
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
),
PremiumDevices AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN t3.tempres = 'Premium' AND t3.humidres = 'Premium' THEN 'Yes' 
            ELSE 'No' 
            END AS is_premium
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
)
SELECT 
    t1.makername, 
    t1.modnum, 
    t1.dpires AS dpi_resolution, 
    t2.pollratehz AS polling_rate, 
    sq.sensor_quality_score, 
    ci.comfort_index, 
    pd.is_premium
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    SensorQuality AS sq ON t1.devregistry = sq.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    ComfortIndex AS ci ON t1.devregistry = ci.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    PremiumDevices AS pd ON t1.devregistry = pd.devregistry
ORDER BY 
    sq.sensor_quality_score DESC, 
    ci.comfort_index DESC;
